instavm-coderunner-public-image-crop-rot.description: Image processing skill for cropping images to 50% from center and rotating them 90 degrees clockwise. This skill should be used when users request image cropping to center, image rotation, or both operations combined on image files.

instavm-coderunner-public-pdf-text-repla.description: Replace text in fillable PDF forms by updating form field values. This skill should be used when users need to update names, addresses, dates, or other text in PDF form fields.
